avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inducer; reduces tetrabenazine levels and increases active metabolites; may also enhance serotonergic effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplements with provider approval

avoid_supplements.name: Tramadol
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Combined serotonergic and monoaminergic activity increases risk of serotonin syndrome and seizures; tetrabenazine depletes monoamines while tramadol increases their activity
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; use alternative analgesics with provider guidance

avoid_supplements.name: 5-HTP
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May cause excessive serotonergic stimulation conflicting with tetrabenazine's monoamine-depleting mechanism; increased seizure and serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid; discuss alternative mood support options with healthcare provider

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor may increase tetrabenazine levels and metabolite accumulation
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased adverse effects (tardive dyskinesia, parkinsonism); adjust dosing if needed

caution_supplements.name: SAMe (S-adenosyl methionine)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance monoamine activity, potentially counteracting tetrabenazine effects or increasing serotonergic tone
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor efficacy and tolerability; report mood changes

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May theoretically enhance sedation and CNS effects of tetrabenazine
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive somnolence; maintain consistent dosing

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor significantly increases tetrabenazine and active metabolite (alpha-DHTBZ) bioavailability; increases risk of accumulation and toxicity
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit products; patient should be counseled on hidden grapefruit in supplements and beverages

caution_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented products)
caution_foods.mechanism: Tetrabenazine depletes monoamines; concurrent high tyramine intake may theoretically increase hypertensive risk if monoamine restoration occurs
caution_foods.action: Maintain moderate tyramine intake; monitor blood pressure; avoid excessive amounts of aged cheeses, soy sauce, or fermented foods

caution_foods.name: Caffeine
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase CNS stimulation and potentiate tremor or akathisia; may also inhibit CYP1A2 metabolism
caution_foods.action: Limit caffeine intake; monitor for increased restlessness, tremor, or insomnia

monitoring_notes: Monitor for worsening or emergence of depression, suicidality, parkinsonism, akathisia, and tardive dyskinesia. CYP2D6 poor metabolizers require dose reduction; obtain CYP2D6 status and monitor for QTc prolongation, particularly when CYP3A4 inhibitors increase metabolite levels.
